desc:
🔧 Run your own Filipino car repair shop! Fix cars and motorcycles, hire mechanics, and grow your talyer into the best repair tycoon in town! 🇵🇭

🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE: Survive the Manananggal raid, earn Bawang, and unlock spooky rides and wrench skins!

🎟️ CODES: TALYER • 500KVISITS • FREEBAYONG • RAID • GARLIC (more in our group!)

⭐ FEATURES
🔧 Repair cars, motorcycles and rare secret rides
🏪 Upgrade your shop with better lifts and new buildings
👨‍🔧 Hire mechanics, cashiers and cleaners
🐾 Collect and raise pets from Bayongs
🚗 Unlock rare lifts and wrench skins
🐕 Survive Filipino street chaos: runaways, thieves and more!

[🛠️] Still in active development. Bug reports and feedback are appreciated!
